notes.title: The Viking Land! Update In Summer
notes.notes:
After 1.0 release we had a lot of new players join in the No Clue world.
It's all been a little overwhelming for us; the questions, the requests... but honestly; it's really been freaking amazing and it warms our hearts to see nearly all of you enjoy the game so much and longing for more!!

Thanks everyone for posting feedback and bug reports, we're trying to track down a couple more small issues, and something that is making late-game performance a bit poor. 

Finally, we're working on the new content - The Viking Land! 

Let us know if you have any issues in steam forums or drop by discord.

Changelist:
1.Added 5 new levels 
2.Added more dynamic content
3.Optimized old levels
4.Bug fixes and improvements
5.Some special content

Can't wait to give you all more and more sneak previews of the new levels!!!
